{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}')

# Check for sentinel value in customer_age
sentinel_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of customers with age -1: {len(sentinel_age)}')

# Inspect revenue column
print('\nSample of revenue values:')
print(df['revenue'].head(10))"}
